status: SOURCE_PREPARATION_ONLY_NOT_ADVERTISED; bindingcatalog projection/capability below are an explicit player-side proposal, not an enabled route
scope: One active verified Plex PMS with explicit current profile/source UUID bindings; no all-configured/inactive/manual-server support

favorites_transfer.receipt_retention_policy: UP TO 86400 seconds, bounded by32 entries/65536 bytes; oldest proved verified/not_applied completions may be evicted earlier only under pressure. Pending/partial/unknown are never evicted. Missing/expired/evicted receipt means unknown, never fresh admission or permission to replay.

capability_prerequisites: No current runtime advertises this object. All modules, exact storage/key codecs, explicit binding authorization and trusted fresh-operation/budget admission must be integrated and qualified first.
Persistent means actual adapter persisted readback, not filesystem fsync or cross-store atomicity. Cookie-backed stores are admitted only when every required readback succeeds.
Limits intersect: byte/node/plan/ledger limits can refuse a collection below its per-list item ceiling; admission never raises caps or evicts uncertain receipts.
projection_rules: Join each public source row to its profile_id profile row; require same provider and both actual private registry.resolve owners/selectors to match the current verified target. Do not pass registry.list().entries directly as wire bindings.

A wire binding is exactly {scope,target_id,codecVersion}; scope carries profile/source UUIDs and provider. Its binding_revision is the outer registry revision encoded as a string. Private selectors/owner data are never returned.

target_id is an opaque runtime-owned association, not a slot, display name, playlist URL, configuration hash or a persistent identity. Only the active verified target is enumerated in this first scope.
The bindings/target projection is not yet registered; Control must not infer or implement an alternative projection. Bindingcatalog/bind remain separate from the frozen seven transfer operations.
store_plan: plex-channel-favorites: exact current TV-source favoritesLibrary document (source identity captured separately from media)
plex-media-favorites: exact current media-source mediaJournal document; history and unrelated fields preserved during the write

favorites-operation-receipts: whole physical ledger; pure original-before→pending plan until commit, then exact CAS/readback reservation immediately before TV/media writes, then planned completion CAS/readback
receipt_rule: Inspect/preview are read-only. The private plan binds physical target keys/order/raw before hashes, original whole-ledger before hash, pending whole-ledger hash, and structured completion after-template. Commit verifies exact original bytes, persists planned pending reservation by CAS/readback, then may write TV/media and complete the receipt. Only the marked plan_digest field is materialized; no marker reaches storage. Real receipts carry counts/outcome/persistence; unknown/partial/pending are never evicted or replayed. Capacity may evict oldest proved completions, so retention is UP TO24h from logical plan timestamp, not a guaranteed replay window.
restart_status: Fresh read-only scope/binding/grant authorization and actual favorite-store projection readback may inspect an old-runtime receipt. Its read-only ledger instance denies CAS. This never revives old write tickets; Control must compare a fresh same-scope snapshot and unchanged binding revision. Retention starts at reservation.
identity_and_missing: Verified PMS + exact string ratingKey is canonical even if the current catalog row is absent. Keep invisible canonical membership, no fallback, no autoplay and no claim of playability. Unportable/ambiguous numeric legacy references block readiness; arbitrary legacy strings refuse complete export rather than disappear.
diagnostics: Only collection/list_index/entry_index/reason are public unresolved diagnostics. For a shuffle baseline, entry_index is entries.length + baseline index; no locator, title, path, URL or token is copied into diagnostics.
unsupported: Foreign paired PMS without explicit rebinding
Empty list collections or present defaults other than the retained generated Favorites default (including null)
Arbitrary unportable legacy strings, negative/unsafe legacy numbers or unsupported reference codecs
Uninitialized or isolated-context media/favorites runtime; inspection never initializes, migrates or writes legacy claims
The first document carries canonical Plex locators and optional title snapshots; it does not assert full folder ancestry or physical file paths
admission_retention: One provisional record is owned by the factory admission object, with one bounded current draft pointer; inspect/preview/abort/expiry/rejected begin perform NO durable writes. At most16 started/uncertain commit admissions are retained per adapter instance. Only fully verified completion releases its slot; persisted operation receipt still rejects replay while retained. New operations require independent trusted fresh admission, never receipt absence.
